root: The four-call design depends on ordinary clean F serving both its own losses and the attached prefix graph of packed V-off/Text-off under real DoRA dropout and non-reentrant checkpointing. Stage1-v3 isolates its auxiliary work in a separate alias graph with a different lifecycle; deleting that graph is not established by its existing tests. If shared F recomputes under the wrong parameter, buffer or dropout context, the new implementation can preserve logits and call counts while silently training a different gradient, invalidating the whole experiment.
first_nail: Before product implementation or distributed training, run one bounded tiny CPU patched-Qwen/DoRA probe that compares the proposed single-F plus independently masked packed OFF graph against literal separate full-sequence masked calls. Hold selected text keys, candidate IDs, reference outputs and alignment noise fixed. Compare clean and OFF outputs, the combined CE/alignment/DIL/entropy/Text-KL gradient for every trainable parameter and live prefix inputs, reference immutability, and observed original decoder calls. Include unequal block/target lengths, dropout 0 and 0.05, and non-reentrant checkpoint recomputation; ensure negative controls for detached prefixes or contaminated V-off text masks fail. Any discrepancy beyond declared tolerances rejects this graph proposal before the expensive run. This probe is proposed only and requires separate explicit authorization.
